Welcome to West Green Primary School
Dear Parents and Carers
I am delighted to have been appointed as Headteacher of West Green Primary School. I have worked at this school for 10 years and consider myself to have been very fortunate to work alongside such wonderful children, the caring and hardworking staff, and not to mention the support I have received from the school’s Governing body.
The opening line in our Ofsted report says “Pupils are proud to attend this nurturing and inclusive school” and it is something to celebrate. In fact, we have taken it to heart and it is one of the first things that visitors see when they enter our school.
We hope you enjoy your time at our school
Mrs Chapman - Headteacher
This success reflects the dedication of your staff and the hard work of your pupils. It shows what can be achieved when ambition and commitment come together. Thank you for everything you do to give children the best possible opportunities to succeed. Your school’s achievements demonstrate what is possible, and I hope you will continue to share your experience and best practice with others.’

Personal, Social and Health Education (PSHE)
“PSHE education gives pupils the knowledge, skills, and attributes they need to keep themselves healthy and safe and to prepare them for life and work in modern Britain.” - PSHE Association
Our PSHE and RSE programme promotes the spiritual, moral, cultural, mental and physical development of pupils at West Green Primary School, preparing them for the opportunities, responsibilities and experiences of later life. Our programme of Study not only reflects the specific needs of the pupils but also reflects the universal needs shared by all pupils.
Through wider school life, we promote PSHE and British values through assemblies, events we take part in, such as Children in Need, and through our everyday interactions and conversations with our pupils.

After School Clubs
At West Green Primary School we are keen to provide a variety of after school activities for our children.
We cannot guarantee all children will get a place in the club they want. If a child is offered a place they will receive an offer letter which must be signed and returned. Any one who did not get into a club will be put down on a waiting list should spaces become available.

Multisport Club (Year 1-3)

Football Club (Year 5-6)
Invite only clubs: This term we are running a range of invite only clubs to help children with specific areas of learning.
Please Note: After School Clubs work in different ways, and so we cannot always guarantee that we can cover them if staff are absent.
